name: How long does it take to repair a slab leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a slab leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of slab leak repair depends on the complexity of the leak and the chosen repair method. Leak detection itself can take a few hours. A direct access repair might be completed within a day or two, assuming minimal water damage to restore. More extensive re-piping or re-routing can take several days to a week. The overall timeline also includes drying and restoration of any water-damaged areas, which can add additional time to the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slab leak repair can take from a few hours for detection to several days for complex repairs or re-piping, plus additional time for water damage restoration.
